svg.title: External toco missing palpable contractions until repositioned
svg.desc: Eight-minute synthetic strip. FHR about 140 bpm with moderate variability. The external toco is nearly flat for 4 minutes while hatched bars mark contractions felt by palpation at 1 and 3 minutes. At 4 minutes the toco is moved over the fundus and secured; clear waves follow at 5 and 7 minutes. Toco height is in relative units only.
